gate: Gate 4 — Real PostgreSQL Runtime, Transactional Invariants, Concurrency and Idempotency Closure

invariants.description: Cross-store mutation attempts are strictly denied without partial writes or side effects.
invariants.positiveTest: Store operator A updates Store A product successfully
invariants.negativeTest: Store operator A attempt to update Store B product is rejected with FORBIDDEN
invariants.concurrencyTest: Concurrent unauthorized edit requests all fail closed
invariants.rollbackTest: Audit entry failure triggers complete mutation rollback

invariants.description: Concurrent checkouts for a product with available quantity N accept exactly N checkouts and reject excess.
requiredLocks: FOR UPDATE on CatalogInventoryLevel ordered by ID ASC
invariants.positiveTest: Single checkout reserves available unit successfully
invariants.negativeTest: Checkout requesting > available quantity is rejected
invariants.concurrencyTest: Concurrent checkouts for 1 unit produce exactly 1 winner and N-1 rejected conflicts
invariants.rollbackTest: Checkout failure after stock reservation rolls back stock level decrement

invariants.description: Duplicate checkout submission with same idempotency key returns identical canonical checkout result.
invariants.negativeTest: Duplicate request with different payload returns conflict error
invariants.concurrencyTest: Concurrent duplicate checkout requests create exactly 1 checkout record
invariants.rollbackTest: Reservation failure during checkout rolls back MarketplaceCheckout creation

invariants.description: Concurrent acceptance of an unassigned dispatch assignment by multiple drivers yields exactly 1 winner.
invariants.positiveTest: Driver A accepts available assignment successfully
invariants.negativeTest: Driver B attempt to accept already assigned delivery returns conflict
invariants.concurrencyTest: Concurrent acceptance requests by 5 drivers result in 1 acceptance and 4 conflicts
invariants.rollbackTest: Driver state update failure rolls back assignment state change

invariants.description: Duplicate delivery completion requests execute idempotently with exactly one earning calculation.
invariants.positiveTest: Delivery completion succeeds and accrues driver earning
invariants.negativeTest: Attempting completion on already completed order returns original completion evidence
invariants.concurrencyTest: Concurrent completion requests yield exactly 1 DriverEarning row
invariants.rollbackTest: Earning accrual failure during completion rolls back delivery status transition

invariants.description: Duplicate payment webhook ITN delivery processes idempotently with exactly one financial state application.
invariants.positiveTest: Payment ITN webhook applies payment SUCCESS state and creates ledger journal
invariants.negativeTest: Corrupted signature ITN webhook is rejected without writing payment state
invariants.concurrencyTest: Concurrent duplicate ITN webhooks create exactly 1 PaymentWebhookEvent and 1 LedgerJournal
invariants.rollbackTest: Ledger posting failure during webhook processing rolls back payment state transition

invariants.description: Out-of-order payment webhooks do not regress terminal payment states.
invariants.positiveTest: Terminal SUCCESS webhook followed by PENDING webhook preserves SUCCESS state
invariants.negativeTest: State regression attempt is ignored or audited without mutation
invariants.concurrencyTest: Out-of-order webhook arrivals resolve deterministically to terminal state
invariants.rollbackTest: Audit recording failure rolls back out-of-order event intake

invariants.description: Concurrent refund requests for a payment cannot exceed original captured payment refundable balance.
requiredLocks: FOR UPDATE on PaymentRecord and PaymentRefund
invariants.positiveTest: Partial refund within allowable ceiling succeeds
invariants.negativeTest: Refund request exceeding remaining balance is rejected
invariants.concurrencyTest: Two concurrent refunds of $60 on a $100 payment result in 1 success and 1 rejection
invariants.rollbackTest: Ledger entry failure during refund creation rolls back PaymentRefund row

invariants.description: Every committed ledger journal has strictly balanced total debits and total credits (net zero).
requiredLocks: FOR UPDATE on LedgerAccount ordered by account number ASC
invariants.positiveTest: Balanced journal creation updates account balances correctly
invariants.negativeTest: Unbalanced journal payload is rejected before database write
invariants.concurrencyTest: Concurrent journal postings against same account maintain numerical balance
invariants.rollbackTest: Account update failure during journal posting rolls back entire journal and all entries

invariants.description: Concurrent withdrawal requests against an available balance cannot cause negative available balance.
invariants.positiveTest: Withdrawal request within available balance reserves funds
invariants.negativeTest: Withdrawal request exceeding available balance is rejected with INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS
invariants.concurrencyTest: Two concurrent withdrawals of $80 against $100 balance result in 1 success and 1 rejection
invariants.rollbackTest: Outbox creation failure during withdrawal request rolls back withdrawal balance reservation

invariants.description: Concurrent workers claiming pending outbox messages select disjoint sets without duplicate processing.
requiredLocks: FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED on OutboxNotificationMessage
invariants.positiveTest: Worker A claims pending batch and processes successfully
invariants.negativeTest: Worker cannot claim already claimed active lease message
invariants.concurrencyTest: 10 concurrent workers claim 50 pending messages with 0 double claims
invariants.rollbackTest: Worker processing failure increments attempt count and sets status to FAILED_RETRYABLE

invariants.description: Sensitive administrative mutations and their immutable security audit entries commit atomically.
requiredLocks: FOR UPDATE on target administrative entity
invariants.positiveTest: Admin action mutates target aggregate and writes audit record in single transaction
invariants.negativeTest: Unauthorized admin action is rejected without mutation or audit entry
invariants.concurrencyTest: Concurrent admin actions produce distinct immutable audit entries
invariants.rollbackTest: Injected audit write error rolls back target administrative entity mutation
